doc: Ch3 'The Shell Shrine' (vertical_slice.md B06; M2-FP-25): the Saltgrass Causeway. Haluna's causeway head (first_playable.json haluna.ending_location) brings the party here; the chapter becomes 3 on arrival (the chapter autosave); the gull harrier at C07 teaches Rhen's niche, then random shallows fights; the islet steps go on to the Shell Shrine trial. The trial, Cutscene B and the Drownbell still run from first_playable.json.
